newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria to celebrate October 8 as Diplomacy Day.
newsitem.headline: Algeria to celebrate October 8 as Diplomacy Day.

text.p: Algeria decreed October 8 as a national Diplomacy Day to celebrate the North African Arab country's diplomacy principles, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Saturday.

"Algeria was the pioneer country to claim a more fair and more balanced international economic relationship to help ensure an economic takeoff in the (non-industrialised) countries," said APS summing up the principles of the country's diplomacy.

The North African country built its diplomacy since independence from French rule 34 years ago by first forging closer links with neighbouring countries in the Maghreb, then with the Arab world, with Moslem nations, Mediterranean Europe and then other countries.

Algeria is current chairman of the Maghreb Arab Union (UMA) set up in 1989 with Morocco, Mauritania, Tunisia and Libya to bring closer their economies and policies as a bargaining tool in the face of the European Union across the Mediterranean.
The country is also the present chairman of the Arab League.
